Title: Free amino acid phenotypes
Legend: Genotype-level free amino acid (FAA) values for the 78 phenotypes used for GWAS, for 280 of the 282 Goodman-Buckler lines (two years x two blocks, Columbia, Missouri). Columns: taxa, then the 78 traits - 20 absolute FAA concentrations (single-letter codes), six biosynthetic-family composites (e.g. LAV, SGC, IVL), 20 ratios to the total pool (AA.Total), 25 ratios to the family composite (e.g. A.LAV), four ratios between amino acids (N.D, N.E, N.Q, Q.E) and three whole-pool traits. Trait codes are defined in Table S2.

Title: Amino acid trait definitions
Legend: Definition of each of the 78 amino acid phenotypes in Table S1 used for GWAS. Columns: metric (trait code), description.

Title: Abundance, variability and heritability of the 20 free amino acids
Legend: For each of the 20 FAAs across 280 lines: median, mean, SD, minimum, maximum, fold range (max/min), coefficient of variation (CV_pct), line-mean broad-sense heritability (H2_line_mean) and genomic heritability (h2_genomic), and the Spearman correlation of line values between 2017 and 2018 (rho_2017_vs_2018; lines measured in both years, n_lines_both_years).

Title: Heritability of FAA and PBAA traits
Legend: Broad-sense and genomic heritability for 40 free (FAA) and 76 protein-bound (PBAA) amino acid traits. Columns: trait, pool, numbers of observations/lines/years and replicates per environment, line-mean H2 and Cullis H2, genomic h2 with 95% CI (h2_lo, h2_hi), mean h2 from permuted phenotypes (h2_permuted_null), whether h2 exceeds the permutation null (h2_reliable), and h2/H2, and the Spearman correlation of line values between 2017 and 2018 (rho_2017_vs_2018) with the number of lines measured in both years.

Title: Free vs protein-bound amino acid pools
Legend: Paired comparison of FAA and PBAA pools across matched lines for total amino acid pool, amino acid-derived N proxy (Asx/Glx = 1.5 N), proline fraction, and Asx + Glx + basic fraction (matched definition, excluding amino acids not measured in both pools). Columns: n lines, mean, median, SD and CV for each pool, fold PBAA/FAA, paired Wilcoxon P.

Title: Amino acid GWAS candidate genes
Legend: All phenotype x SNP x gene combinations for SNPs significant at 5% Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (per phenotype and model; MLM, BLINK, FarmCPU) that lie within 25 kb of a B73 RefGen_v5 gene: 1,811 SNPs, 71 phenotypes, 3,693 genes. Columns: phenotype, SNP (name carries the AGPv3 coordinate), chromosome, AGPv4 position (genotype data) and B73 RefGen_v5 position (lifted with the v4-to-v5 chain file; lift = gap marks SNPs placed at the nearest aligned base), number and names of significant models, lowest P and FDR, replicated (significant in >= 2 models), gene ID, gene start/end, position relative to gene and distance (bp).

Title: Amino acid GWAS loci
Legend: Significant SNPs (5% FDR) merged into loci when within 25 kb of each other (the gene-annotation window), pooled across phenotypes: 2,152 loci (1,571 with a gene within 25 kb). Columns: locus ID, chromosome, start/end (B73 RefGen_v5), number of SNPs and phenotypes, phenotypes, best P, lead SNP with AGPv4 and v5 positions, replicated (>= 2 models), models at the lead SNP and at any SNP, number of genes, gene IDs and labels within 25 kb, top gene and its name, PANTHER family, protein class and GO terms, and the nearest gene and its distance.

Title: Soil-N GWAS candidate genes
Legend: The 448 B73 RefGen_v5 genes within 25 kb of the 216 soil-N SNPs that lie near a gene (one row per gene x SNP). SNP-level columns as in Table S10, followed by gene start/end, position relative to gene, distance (bp), gene name, PANTHER family, protein class and GO biological process / molecular function terms.

Title: Environmental GWAS overlap test
Legend: Observed vs expected numbers of shared FDR-significant SNPs (MLM, BLINK and FarmCPU combined). Top block: each variable vs the union of geographic variables (latitude, longitude, elevation; the variable itself excluded). Bottom block: soil N (0-5 cm) vs each other variable. Expected = n1 x n2 / 495,755; one-sided hypergeometric P. Assumes independent traits, so enrichment between correlated variables (e.g. the two soil-N depths, r = 0.84) is overstated.

Title: Soil-N GWAS SNPs and overlap with other environmental GWAS
Legend: All 234 SNPs significant for soil N (0-5 cm) at 5% FDR in MLM, BLINK or FarmCPU (3,107 landraces, 495,755 SNPs, 3 PCs). Columns: SNP, MAF, chromosome, position, P per model (blank = not significant in that model), number of models, lowest P; 1/0 whether the SNP is also FDR-significant in the GWAS of CEC, aridity, elevation, latitude, longitude and pH; number of such variables (n_env) and of geographic ones (n_geog); their names (env_hits); also significant for soil N at 5-15 cm (replicates_N_5_15); genes within 25 kb and the nearest (lead) gene with distance, name and PANTHER family; evidence class.

Title: Genotype-environment correlation test for soil-N SNPs
Legend: For each of the 234 soil-N SNPs: Pearson r between genotype (0/1/2 allele copies) and soil N (0-5 and 5-15 cm), latitude, longitude, elevation, pH, CEC and aridity across 3,107 landraces (r_ columns), and the SNP's genome-wide rank for each variable as the % of the 495,755 SNPs with a stronger correlation (pct_ columns; 0.1 = top 0.1%). Also: best geographic and best non-N rank, the variable giving it, environmental GWAS hits, and the call - linked to environment (top 1% for any non-N variable), not linked (top 5% for soil N, not top 1% for any other variable), or inconclusive (weak soil-N correlation, outside the top 5%; signal detected only by the multi-locus models).

Title: Expectation test for the genotype-environment correlation
Legend: Share of SNPs in the top 1% of the genome for at least one geographic variable (latitude, longitude, elevation) or at least one of six non-N variables (+ pH, CEC, aridity), for the whole genome, for SNPs in the top 1% for correlation with soil N, for all soil-N GWAS SNPs and for those significant in >= 2 models. Columns: group, axis set, n SNPs, k in top 1%, %, binomial P vs whole genome (greater) and vs soil-N-correlated SNPs (less).

Title: Free amino acid metrics, Cycle 0 vs Cycle 14
Legend: Eight pre-specified FAA metrics per population (total FAA per mg; Pro, Asn, Asp, Gln, Glu fractions of total FAA; Asn+Gln+Arg+Lys+His per mg; FAA-derived N per mg), tested on biological samples (3 technical replicates averaged; Indian Chief C0 n=5, C14 n=8; Jarvis C0 n=3, C14 n=8). Columns: population, metric, description, n and mean/median per cycle, two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum P (normal approximation), Benjamini-Hochberg P across the eight metrics, Cliff's delta (C14 vs C0), direction, significant_BH.
